query: A work-item detail page must render the not-found page when the record is missing, and the create Server Action must redirect to the new item on success. Both paths call the work-items capability.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent calls notFound() or redirect() inside a generic catch that also normalises application failures. Next.js control-flow signals are converted into ordinary failures, so the page renders an error state and the redirect never happens.
expected_behavior: Keeps navigation in the Next.js runtime surface: the capability returns not_found or a value, then rsc.ts or actions.ts calls notFound() or redirect()
Keeps application operations free of Next.js control-flow exceptions
Avoids a mixed catch; treats unstable_rethrow only as a limited migration workaround that the docs mark unstable and not recommended for production
Adds tests asserting that redirect and not-found rendering survive the capability call
anti_expectation: Does NOT disable failure normalisation to make navigation work
Does NOT import Next.js navigation into domain/ or application/
Does NOT move the business decision into app/** to avoid the capability
